description:
Manage Focus time-entries with the following actions:

- **archive**: Archive Time Entries. (data: time_entry_id*)
- **bulk-create**: Bulk Create Time Entries. JSON array of entries with task_id, start, duration, type ('activity'|'break'). One HTTP request for many creates. Datetime fields (start, planned_start, planned_at, tracked_at) must be RFC3339 with a timezone (e.g. 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z or 2026-04-01T11:00:00+02:00), not YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. (data: array payload)
- **bulk-delete**: Bulk Delete Time Entries. Soft-delete multiple time entries by id in one request. (data: ids*)
- **bulk-edit**: Bulk Edit Time Entries. (data: payload*{changes*, ids*})
- **bulk-patch**: Bulk Patch Time Entries. JSON array of { id: timeEntryId, ...partial fields } for bulk partial update. Datetime fields (start, planned_start, planned_at, tracked_at) must be RFC3339 with a timezone, or null to clear. (data: array payload)
- **bulk-restore**: Bulk Restore Time Entries. Restore deleted time entries by id in one request. (data: ids*)
- **bulk-set-day-duration**: Bulk Set Day Duration Time Entries. (data: payload*)
- **constraints-list**: Constraints List Time Entries. (data: none)
- **constraints-upsert**: Constraints Upsert Time Entries. (data: payload*{enabled*, required_fields*, disallow_billable_override})
- **create**: Create a completed task time entry. payload.type defaults to 'activity' when omitted. Logs a completed task time entry. payload.type defaults to 'activity' when omitted; pass 'break' explicitly for a break. provide payload.start and payload.duration for completed tracked time. payload.start must be RFC3339 with a timezone (e.g. 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z or 2026-04-01T11:00:00+02:00), not YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. (data: payload*{...}, task_id*)
- **create-taskless**: Create a completed taskless time entry. payload.type defaults to 'activity' when omitted. Logs a completed taskless time entry. payload.type defaults to 'activity' when omitted; pass 'break' explicitly for a break. (data: payload*{...})
- **delete**: Delete Time Entries. (data: time_entry_id*)
- **get**: Get Time Entries. (data: time_entry_id*)
- **get-batch**: Get Batch Time Entries. (data: ids*)
- **get-stream-time-entries-range**: Get Stream Time Entries Range Time Entries. (data: archived*, date_from*, date_to*, expand_calendar_event*, include_taskless*, order_by*, status_id*, task_id*, type*)
- **get-stream-time-entries-time-block-ids**: Get Stream Time Entries Time Block Ids Time Entries. (data: time_block_id*)
- **get-task-time-entries**: Get Task Time Entries Time Entries. (data: archived, order_by, page, per_page, task_id*, time_block_id, type)
- **groups-get-users**: Groups Get Users Time Entries. (data: end_date*, order_by*, page*, per_page*, start_date*, user_id*)
- **list**: List Time Entries. Returns tracked time entries in a date range, including taskless entries (tracked on a project with no task). Requires date_from and date_to. Accepts date-only strings (YYYY-MM-DD) or RFC3339 datetimes — date-only is automatically expanded: date_from to T00:00:00Z, date_to to T23:59:59Z. Optional project_id keeps only entries on that project (sent to the API; client also scans up to 50 list pages of 100, then slices page/per_page; not a full workspace scan). If truncated is true, more unfiltered rows exist than were scanned — narrow date_from/date_to. Pass include_taskless:false to hide taskless rows. Includes task and project context. (data: date_from*, date_to*, project_id, task_id, time_block_id, type, include_taskless, page, per_page)
- **log-planned-time**: Log Planned Time Time Entries. (data: time_entry_id*)
- **partial-update**: Partial Update Time Entries. (data: payload*{billable, duration, reset_billable_to_default, type}, time_entry_id*)
- **restore**: Restore Time Entries. (data: time_entry_id*)
- **set-day-duration**: Set Day Duration Time Entries. (data: payload*{date_from*, date_to*, duration*, discriminant, start_time, task_id})
- **start**: Start Time Entries. type defaults to 'activity' if omitted; pass type:'break' to start a break. Optionally provide task_id, project_id, description, and time_block_id. Optional start must be RFC3339 with a timezone (e.g. 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z or 2026-04-01T11:00:00+02:00). Only one timer can be active at a time — stops the current one if running. (data: type, description, project_id, start, task_id, time_block_id)
- **stop**: Stop Time Entries. Stops the currently running timer. No input required. (data: none)
- **sync**: Sync Time Entries. (data: client_uuid*, payload*{billable_source*, client_updated_at*, type*, billable})
- **tracking-get-tracked-time-entry**: Tracking Get Tracked Time Entry Time Entries. (data: none)
- **tracking-start-tracking-from-description**: Tracking Start Tracking From Description Time Entries. (data: payload*{...})
- **unarchive**: Unarchive Time Entries. (data: time_entry_id*)
- **update**: Update Time Entries. (data: payload*{type*, calendar_event_id, description, duration, planned_at, planned_duration, planned_start, start, time_block_id, tracked_at}, time_entry_id*)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: archive, bulk-create, bulk-delete, bulk-edit, bulk-patch, bulk-restore, bulk-set-day-duration, constraints-list, constraints-upsert, create, create-taskless, delete, get, get-batch, get-stream-time-entries-range, get-stream-time-entries-time-block-ids, get-task-time-entries, groups-get-users, list, log-planned-time, partial-update, restore, set-day-duration, start, stop, sync, tracking-get-tracked-time-entry, tracking-start-tracking-from-description, unarchive, update

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.
